notes: Measured from all three AI594 LOD0 Silver linden layout.json files. Coordinates are Blender Z-up, local to the model; crownBounds contain outer-card corners only, excluding oversized transparent core cards.

Each normalized point is the corresponding accepted five-center canopy position divided by that variant's outer-card bounds. Use these as partition seeds and fit final panels to the selected source geometry, not to a fixed spherical crown.

Outer-card crown spans in metres: mature_01 9.127 x 8.217 x 11.947, mature_02 9.491 x 8.928 x 11.312, mature_03 8.957 x 7.563 x 11.714. Retain the vertically tiered, tapered crown and the low lateral lobes.

Five sides and four open rings yield 30 trunk triangles. Prefer ring heights near the root flare, 1.4 metres, the first fork near 4 metres, and the selected crown tip height. Fit the connected main stem, preserving lateral drift, and put finer fork silhouettes into alpha captures.

Measured lower-trunk section radii are about 0.50-0.67 metres at 0.12 metres height and 0.28-0.36 metres at 1.4-2.8 metres. Trunk section centers drift up to 0.34 metres horizontally by 2.8 metres. Whole-section bounds above about 4.2 metres include branch forks and must not set the trunk radius.

Review from the existing -72 degree azimuth at 2.2 metres bus-eye height, then perpendicular and rear azimuths. Protect the raised crown skirt, visible forks, slender summit, and asymmetric side lobes rather than closing all holes with dense panels.

Preserve pale leaf undersides and coherent branchlet detail in the baked alpha material. Avoid excessive bright underside coverage or an opaque triangular crown when the vertical panel intersections overlap.

For LOD6 vary all three mature silhouettes within the ten-tree cluster, stagger their heights and depth, and retain trunk gaps below the crown line. A single two-triangle group plate amortizes to 0.2 triangles per tree; do not duplicate backfaces.
